1.why: Clean sans-serif typography with clear spacing is used consistently across screens.

2.why: Text formatting avoids dense paragraphs, italics, and upper-case block styles.

3.why: Layouts are well-proportioned for mobile viewports without crowding.

4.why: Direct, plain-language prompts are provided at each stage.

5.why: Input fields feature illustrative placeholder text showing required format.

6.why: Screens limit text content to brief summary sentences.

7.why: Explicit copy buttons are available for setup secrets and backup keys.

8.why: A visual QR code option is provided for authenticator configuration.

9.why: Standard form fields are compatible with browser password management tools.

10.why: Header progress bars and distinct primary buttons highlight key actions.

11.why: Layouts emphasize a single prominent call-to-action button per screen.

12.why: Feedback banners confirm completed actions and describe the next step.

13.why: Users can toggle code visibility and request new tokens freely.

14.why: Error notifications state the issue and remedy without user fault.

15.why: Page expiry alerts indicate active session timeouts are present.
